correctness.rationale: The quotient singularity calculation reduces to 1/a(1^r), whose minimum nontrivial age is r/a. Fletcher's criterion reduces exactly to two divisibility branches: a|r, or a|(r-1) with at least m distinct unit-coordinate rescue directions, i.e. r>=m. The divisor counts follow by gcd(r,r-1)=1. The packaged generic subset checker independently matches the theorem on 128 small parameter triples and checks the counting formulas through r,m<=100.

value.rationale: The result gives a complete uniform existence criterion and exact counts for a natural three-parameter weighted-projective family, exposing a structural phase transition at r=m caused by Jacobian rank on the full singular stratum. This is not merely a recomputation of a finite table: it explains when anticanonical Calabi--Yau hypersurfaces can be general and quasismooth across all repeated-heavy multiplicities.
